permissions.keyboardRecovery: Accessibility is allowed, but keyboard capture has not connected. Restart Screen Buoy first. If the issue persists, try allowing Input Monitoring.
permissions.title: Allow Accessibility access
permissions.description: Allow Screen Buoy in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility to find controls and click them.
permissions.recovery: Enable the copy shown below in System Settings. After replacing the app, you may need to remove its old permission entry, add it again, and restart Screen Buoy.

keyboard.propagationModifierTooltip: Modifier keys (e.g. Alt, Ctrl, Shift, Win) that will be ignored by the app, allowing their events to pass through to other windows.
keyboard.availableKeysTooltip: Define the keys available for shortcuts and their platform key codes.
keyboard.hintKeyTooltip: The physical key corresponding to the last character of the current hint.
keyboard.hintRightKeyTooltip: The physical key immediately to the right of HintKey, as defined in the leftRightMapping table below.
keyboard.hintLeftKeyTooltip: The physical key immediately to the left of HintKey, as defined in the leftRightMapping table below.
keyboard.leftRightMappingTooltip: Define left/right relationships for keys. Used for flexible combos and directional actions.

keybinding.mainHotkeyTooltip: The main hotkey to activate and show hints. Uses Tauri shortcut format: Alt = Option, Ctrl = Control, Super = Command on macOS.
keybinding.moveToHintTooltip: Move the mouse cursor to the selected hint.
keybinding.moveAndExitTooltip: Move the mouse cursor to the selected hint and exit hint mode.
keybinding.leftClickAndExitTooltip: Left click the selected hint and exit hint mode.
keybinding.holdAtHintTooltip: Enter Hold mode at the selected hint position.
keybinding.leftClickTooltip: Left click at the hint position.
keybinding.doubleClickTooltip: Double left click at the hint position.
keybinding.doubleClickAndExitTooltip: Double left click at the hint position and exit hint mode.
keybinding.rightClickTooltip: Right click at the hint position.
keybinding.rightClickAndExitTooltip: Right click at the hint position and exit hint mode.
keybinding.middleClickTooltip: Middle click at the hint position.
keybinding.middleClickAndExitTooltip: Middle click at the hint position and exit hint mode.
keybinding.dragUpTooltip: Drag up at the hint position.
keybinding.dragDownTooltip: Drag down at the hint position.
keybinding.dragLeftTooltip: Drag left at the hint position.
keybinding.dragRightTooltip: Drag right at the hint position.
keybinding.scrollUpTooltip: Scroll up at the hint position.
keybinding.scrollDownTooltip: Scroll down at the hint position.
keybinding.scrollLeftTooltip: Scroll left at the hint position.
keybinding.scrollRightTooltip: Scroll right at the hint position.

hint.charsetsTooltip: Characters used for hints. The first character of each hint comes from the first charset row, the second from the second row, and so on.
hint.charsetExtraTooltip: When the number of hints exceeds the available characters, these extra characters will be used. Extra characters are added as the first character of the hint; subsequent characters cycle through the main charsets.
hint.rowsTooltip: Number of rows to divide the screen into for displaying hints at fixed positions.
hint.columnsTooltip: Number of columns to divide the screen into for displaying hints at fixed positions.
hint.showAtRowsTooltip: After dividing the screen into rows, show hints only at the specified rows.
hint.showAtColumnsTooltip: After dividing the screen into columns, show hints only at the specified columns.
hint.hintTypeTooltip: The hint type used for grid-generated hints, controls the style of these hints.
hint.styleCssTooltip: Custom CSS style for this hint type.
hint.zIndexTooltip: z-index for this hint type. Controls stacking order when hints overlap.
hint.elementControlTypesTooltip: Element control types associated with this hint type. See Windows UI Automation control type IDs.
hint.placeholderCharset: Enter the charset, separated by commas
hint.placeholderCharsetExtra: Enter the extra charset, separated by commas

mouse.movementStepTooltip: Configure the amount and direction of mouse movement for each step. Used for keyboard-based mouse navigation.
mouse.scrollStepTooltip: Configure the amount and direction of scrolling for each step. Used for keyboard-based scrolling.
mouse.dragStepTooltip: Configure the amount and direction of mouse movement for each step during drag operations.
mouse.modifiersTooltip: Modifier keys that must be held to trigger this step. Leave empty for no modifier requirement.

system.loggingLevelTooltip: Set the logging level. Select 'none' to disable all logging output.
system.debugModeTooltip: In debug mode, the position of the hint window will be displayed.

uiAutomation.collectIntervalTooltip: Minimum interval between background scans. Valid caches skip scans; switching windows, clicking, or opening hints prioritizes related windows.
uiAutomation.cacheTtlTooltip: How long completed scans can be reused in the background; recommended: 60000 ms. Interaction refreshes and live hint updates bypass this limit.

settings.title: Settings

description.keybinding: Make every action feel natural. Set the keys you use to navigate and click.
description.mouse: Fine-tune movement, scrolling and dragging for each modifier combination.
description.hint: Choose the characters, grid and appearance of your on-screen hints.
description.uiAutomation: Control how often Screen Buoy finds and refreshes interface elements.
description.keyboard: Manage modifier keys, key codes and neighboring key relationships.
description.system: Manage startup, app updates, tray visibility and diagnostics.

groups.activation: Your shortcut to show hints, from any application.
groups.global: Actions available while entering a hint.
groups.atHint: Actions available while holding the final hint key.
groups.detectionDescription: Time in milliseconds between element scans and before cached results expire.
groups.gridDescription: Place hints at fixed positions across the screen.
groups.typesDescription: Customize appearance and element assignments for each hint type.

help.startAtLogin: Launch Screen Buoy when you sign in.
help.startInTray: Keep the settings window hidden on startup.
help.showTrayIcon: Keep Screen Buoy accessible from the menu bar or system tray.

settings.saveError: Could not save settings. Please try your change again.

updates.title: App updates
updates.description: Check GitHub Releases when you need to. No background update checks.
updates.installHelp: The update is verified before installation. Your settings are preserved. Installation may close the app; on macOS, you may need to allow Accessibility again.
updates.manualHelp: Download this release from GitHub Releases. In-app installation is not available for this release.
updates.ready: Update installed. Restart to use the new version.
updates.failed: The operation could not be completed. Review the error details and try again.
updates.manifestUnavailable: The release update manifest is not ready. Please try again later.
